positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As a Christian, Sheri believes all life is made in the image and likeness of God and it must be cherished. Like many women, Sheri faced significant challenges bringing life into this world, including multiple miscarriages and bed rest orders during her son’s pregnancy. Yet, despite the challenges, Sheri always thanked God for the beautiful creations He blessed her with. AS our Member of Congress, Sheri will use her voice and story to protect the sanctity of life and advance a true culture of life in this country."

"Kamala Harris's visit to an abortion clinic is despicable. While the Biden Administration continues to push policies that go against morality and core American beliefs - I remain steadfast in the understanding that the sanctity of life, the importance of family, and Judeo-Christian values have long defined the strength of our nation. I am committed to advocating for policies that protect the unborn, support families, and ensure our values are not just preserved but cherished. Let's stand together in defense of life!"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Career politicians, career bureaucrats, and career candidates will not fix the problems our nation faces. I am proud to be the conservative outsider in this race and offer my lifetime of public service as a military officer and health care professional. As our next Member of Congress, I will fight to stop illegal immigration, tackle inflation, and ensure promises made to our veterans are kept."

"If the House’s vote today to give away $95 billion to other countries - while our border is wide open for illegals - doesn’t make you sick, the waving of Ukraine’s flag on the floor of the house definitely should. Today’s vote and conduct make me sick. Stop giving away money to other countries. Secure our border. Take care of our veterans. America First, not America Last."

"No more federal funds to sanctuary cities. Build the wall. Deport. Return to sanity. Put America First. Prioritize American families struggling to buy grocery. Prioritize veterans struggling to get the care and resources they deserve. Prioritize the safety of our nation and secure the border."

"The border crisis represents one of the most critical challenges facing our nation today - affecting each and every one of us, directly or indirectly, and undermining the very fabric of our society, our economy, and our national security. As our next Member of Congress, Sheri will work tirelessly to build the wall, stop the flow of illegal aliens and drugs into our country, and replace "catch-and-release" with "stop-and-deport."
